ideas.pitch: An autonomous rover delivery system that uses AI to navigate campus obstacles and releases USDC escrow payments on the MST Blockchain only upon optical confirmation of package delivery.
ideas.title: MST-Newrro Autonomous Delivery Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the core strengths of both co-organizers—MST Blockchain and Newrro's robotics expertise—directly targeting the intersection of autonomous systems and Web3 payments.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) node run by an AI agent that automatically detects anomalies in local IoT sensor feeds and settles micro-bounties on MST Blockchain.
ideas.title: Agentic DePIN Grid Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages DePIN and AI Agents, two explicitly highlighted domains in the hackathon brief, while showing functional hardware-software integration.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered smart garbage sorting robotic bin that issues tokenized Real-World Asset (RWA) recycling credits onto the MST Blockchain based on material classification.
ideas.title: RWA Automated Waste Sorting Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the RWA and Robotics themes by turning physical sorting actions into verifiable on-chain assets, creating a strong physical demo for judges.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge access control system allowing only verified human operators or authorized AI agent sub-networks to dispatch campus security and delivery robots.
ideas.title: ZK-Gated Autonomous Robot Fleet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings hard engineering (ZK-proofs and robotics security) to a hackathon co-hosted by a Layer 1 blockchain and a robotics firm, standing out from standard web apps.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent integrated into messaging platforms that executes cross-border or local consumer crypto payments on the MST Blockchain using natural language commands.
ideas.title: MST Consumer Payment AI Concierge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Consumer Payments and AI Agents focus areas while providing a polished, highly demonstrable user interface that works out of the box.
